---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a repository or plugin capability with explicit ownership and evidence boundaries
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Goal

What user outcome should this change enable?

## Ownership and scope

Which service/plugin should own the capability? If it is cross-service, identify the owning service for transport and consequential writes.

## Proposed contract

Describe inputs, outputs, limitations, references, and whether the change is read-only, preview-only, or consequential.

## Safety and evidence

Explain approval requirements, untrusted-data handling, provenance/limitations, and any external API facts that require fresh verification.

## Compatibility / SemVer

State whether this is repository-only or changes a plugin public/runtime/documentation contract and therefore may require a plugin SemVer release.
